grammar.title: so...that... 结构

examples: Marshall was so devastated that he couldn't get out of bed.

The apartment felt so empty that it echoed.

grammar.title: 方位介词：in/on/at 的抽象用法

grammar.title: as if + 从句：仿佛，好像

grammar.explanation: 直接引语：She said, 'I made a mistake.' 间接引语：She said (that) she had made a mistake. 间接引语中时态要往后退一步（过去式→过去完成时）。注意人称和代词的变化。
